answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a per-identity stake slashed on proof of duplicate control, sized to exceed the expected reward of one extra fake actor. Every new address must lock the same bond before mining, so each clone costs the full stake and attack budget grows linearly while rewards split across clones. Duplicates are collapsed through attestations sharing a funding source or a bridge withdrawal trail, so a zephyr of disposable keys gains nothing. Each orchard of linked accounts must hold independent reserves, pricing deception in locked capital rather than free signup.
